summary: JSON pretty printing is implemented but untested: I was not allowed to run anything. Changes: JSONHighlighter in rich/highlighter.py; six json.* theme styles in rich/default_styles.py; the JSON renderable and a `python -m rich.json FILE` entry point in rich/json.py; Console.print_json in rich/console.py; package-level print_json in rich/__init__.py; docs (console.rst "Printing JSON" section, reference/json.rst, toctree entry); a CHANGELOG Unreleased entry; and tests/test_json.py with a Console test and a package-level test. Nothing was committed. The console test's expected ANSI codes were derived by reading rich/style.py, so verify that test first.
